summary.text: Dan Crenshaw was elected in November 2018 to represent Texas's 2nd Congressional District.

paragraphs.text: He graduated from Tufts University in 2006 through Navy ROTC and served ten years in the Navy SEAL Teams, retiring in 2016 as a Lieutenant Commander.
He later earned a Master of Public Administration from the Harvard Kennedy School of Government and returned to the Houston area, where he is from.
